articles.summary: Business Wire: AMCON Distributing Company Reports Results for the Quarter Ended December 31, 2025. OMAHA, Neb., January 19, 2026--AMCON Distributing Company ("AMCON" or "the Company") (NYSE American: DIT), an Omaha, Nebraska based Convenience and Foodservice Distributor, is pleased to announce fully diluted earnings per share of $1.28 on net income available to common shareholders of $0.8 million for its first fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2025. articles.title: How The SITE Centers SITC Story Is Shifting With NAV Cuts And Special Dividends
articles.mainIdea: How The SITE Centers SITC Story Is Shifting With NAV Cuts And Special Dividends
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How The SITE Centers SITC Story Is Shifting With NAV Cuts And Special Dividends. Analysts have refreshed their view on SITE Centers with a modest trim to fair value, from US$10.13 to US$9.63, paired with a slight uptick in the discount rate from 8.42% to 8.45%. This reset reflects updated net asset value work that folds in recent and pending asset sales and special dividends. Bullish voices see this as a cleaner alignment between the stock and the underlying real estate base, while more cautious analysts highlight the reduced NAV as a headwind for equity value.
